items.rationale: Covered under 5.2.6(b) as necessary to determine the cause and extent of the loss; reference cases 20 and 21 show t >= 481 for similar work.
Covered under 5.2.6(a) as necessary to locate the leak; reference cases 20 and 21 show t >= 449–707 for similar work.
Technician time for leak detection is covered under 5.2.6(a); reference case 21 (service technician hours) suggests t ≈ 45–48 per hour, so for 2.5 hrs, t ≈ 112.
One vehicle charge per contractor per invoice is covered up to EUR 70 net (5.2.6(c)); reference cases confirm this cap.

items.description: Repair of the copper joints verified as actively leaking (seal/renew failed sections)
items.rationale: Repair of only the leaking sections is covered under 2.4.3 and 7.1.5; reference case 21 (repair and replacement of leaking copper pipe) shows t between 157 and 220.

items.description: Precautionary replacement of the remaining original copper supply run (sections not themselves shown to be leaking)
items.rationale: Work on sections not themselves shown to be leaking is excluded by 2.4.3 and 7.1.5; reference cases 20 and 21 confirm only affected parts are covered.

items.description: Upgrade surcharge – premium multilayer composite piping in lieu of standard copper
items.rationale: Upgrades beyond pre-loss standard are excluded by 7.1.9; only like-for-like reinstatement is indemnified.
One vehicle charge per contractor per invoice is covered up to EUR 70 net (5.2.6(c)); reference cases confirm this cap.
